commit_message:
[GPU][Codegen] Choose VDMFMA intrinsics for 16bit input skinny gemms (#24103)

Adds 16 bit VDMFMA candidates to the TileAndFuse intrinsic selection for
skinny gemms (5 < M < 9) for CDNA3.

Performance comparison:

CDNA3:
```
  shape                     vdmfma      baseline    %
  ------------------------  ----------  ----------  -------
  f16_8x13312x16384        189 us      206 us      +8.3%
  f16_8x13312x8192         117 us      116 us      -
  f16_8x2304x16384         133 us      138 us      +3.6%
  f16_8x2304x8192          103 us      110 us      +6.4%
  f16_8x6656x16384         127 us      130 us      +2.3%
  f16_8x6656x8192          102 us      109 us      +6.4%
```

VDMFMAs use sparse MFMA instructions, which have twice the depth as
dense MFMA variants. Because of this, their compute phase is noticeably
shorter. On VDMFMA selection, we double the K reduction tile so the
compute phase is long enough to hide global memory latency effectively
in software pipelining. This brings the performance against the baseline
in line with the above figures.

As part of https://github.com/iree-org/iree/issues/22863

commit_message:
[Codegen] Cap DMA per-lane width to min contiguous size of src/dest (#24305)

When `gather_to_lds` copies from a strided source (e.g.
`memref<256x4xf8E8M0FNU, strided<[256, 1]>>`), the
inner contiguous dimension may be smaller than what 128-bit DMA reads
per lane. This would cross row boundaries and pull bytes from unrelated
rows.

Fix: compute the contiguous trailing linear size for both source and
destination, and pass `maxElementsPerLane = min(srcLinearSize,
destLinearSize)` into `computeTransferSegments`.

Assisted-by: Cursor (Claude)

commit_message:
[Codegen][GPU] Avoid generic TileAndFuse promotion for convolutions. (#24435)

Generic TileAndFuse promotion can attach promote_operands to convolution
ops that did not go through a convolution-specific MMA config path.
Those paths are responsible for selecting an MMA schedule and attaching
mma_kind.

Skip generic contraction promotion for convolution ops so direct conv
and IGEMM configs remain the only promoted convolution paths.

This fixes NaN issues for ResNet ONNX models.

Fixes https://github.com/iree-org/iree/issues/24414

commit_message:
[LLVMGPU] Avoid degenerate SIMT matmul unit tiles (#24425)

The motivation for this PR is to avoid poor SIMT tiling choices for
large mixed-precision matmuls that appear in LLM workloads. We skip
exact-match SIMT matmul configs that tile a non-skinny parallel
dimension by one element, so large mixed-precision matmuls do not end up
with only one useful lane dimension per workgroup. We also add a
regression test for the 36x151936x896 f32xbf16xf32 matmul shape that
previously selected a [1, 128, 8] workgroup tile.

commit_message:
[Tokenizer] Fix ByteLevel decoder: hybrid pre-decode with UTF-8 accumulator (#24039)

The ByteLevel decoder was declared STATELESS, causing the decode
pipeline to pre-decode each token in isolation. This breaks multi-byte
UTF-8 reconstruction where bytes from one token combine with the next
(e.g., "Ã"+"ĳ" → bytes C3 91 → "Ñ").

Add STATELESS_EXCEPT_PARTIAL_UTF8 capability: a hybrid approach that
pre-decodes most vocab entries (99.3% for GPT-2) at build time, and
routes partial-UTF-8 tokens through an inline byte accumulator at decode
time. Partial tokens are identified by trial-decoding each token at
build time and recorded in a slab-embedded bitmap (vocab_capacity/8
bytes, ~6KB for GPT-2). Offsets remain pure byte positions with no
bit-packing or masking.

Decode throughput (GPT-2, ASCII text):
 - STATELESS (broken):     192M tok/s  — incorrect Unicode
 - CAPABILITY_NONE:         59M tok/s  — correct, 3.2x slower
 - PARTIAL_UTF8 (bitmap):  169M tok/s  — correct, 88% of original

HF smoketest: 1667/1667 pass. Tiktoken: 76/76 pass.
Unicode roundtrip verified: café, Ñoño, 你好世界, hello 😀 world.

Signed-off-by: Jorn <jorn.tuyls@gmail.com>
Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
name: sdxl/clip_benchmark_cpu.json

`hasUnfusableUseInDispatch()` that was dropped in #24214, so
`tensor.insert_slice` dest uses outside the dispatch being analyzed do
not block producer cloning.

`flow.dispatch.workgroups` results are tied to the same input operand.
Also restores the dispatch ownership check in
`hasUnfusableUseInDispatch()` that was dropped in #24214, so
`tensor.insert_slice` dest uses outside the dispatch being analyzed do
not block producer cloning.

Fixes https://github.com/iree-org/iree/issues/24385

[Codegen] Fix ND vector elementwise unroll operands (#24458)

This crashed when compiling a proprietary model.

Unroll elementwise ops by grouping converted operands per result lane
and reuse single-value operand lists across all lanes. This handles
cases like scalar select predicates while keeping split vector operands
paired with their converted result lanes via zip_equal.

Add coverage for scalar and vector arith.select predicates, a 3-D
scalar-predicate select, and arith.cmpi so non-select elementwise ops
with different operand/result element types stay covered.

This crashed when compiling a proprietary model.

Unroll elementwise ops by grouping converted operands per result lane
and reuse single-value operand lists across all lanes. This handles
cases like scalar select predicates while keeping split vector operands
paired with their converted result lanes via zip_equal.

Add coverage for scalar and vector arith.select predicates, a 3-D
scalar-predicate select, and arith.cmpi so non-select elementwise ops
with different operand/result element types stay covered.
